pageDescription: Find and remove duplicate files to reclaim disk space
confirmRecycleDesc: {{count}} files ({{size}}) will be moved to the recycle bin.
confirmPermanentDesc: {{count}} files ({{size}}) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirmHardLinkDesc: {{count}} files ({{size}}) will be unified via NTFS hard links without removing them from their folders. Games (such as Assetto Corsa) keep all their files and audio intact while duplicate disk space is reclaimed.
hardLinkSuccess: Hard-linked {{count}} files without deleting them, recovered {{size}}
keepOneCopy: At least one copy must be kept
hardLinkedCopy: Other hard links keep this file, so deleting it would free no space
protectGameFiles: Protect game, audio bank, and application files
protectGameFilesDesc: Prevents deleting sound banks (.bank, GUIDs.txt, FMOD/Wwise), 3D models (.kn5, .acd), and game folders such as Assetto Corsa or Steam
protectedTooltip: Critical game or audio asset locked from deletion to prevent missing sound. Switch to 'Hard Link (Keep Files)' mode to reclaim space safely.
distinctNamesTooltip: These files have identical content but different filenames (common when multiple cars or mods share the same sound bank).
protectionBannerTitle: Game & Audio Protection Active ({{count}} protected files)
protectionBannerDesc: Game audio and asset files (such as Assetto Corsa .bank / GUIDs.txt) were automatically locked against deletion so your games never lose sound. To reclaim space on them without deleting any file, select 'Hard Link (Keep Files)' mode.
emptyDescription: No duplicate files were found with the current settings.
idleDescription: Select a directory to scan for duplicate files and reclaim wasted disk space.
scanCancelled: Scan was cancelled — showing partial results.
